title: Synthetic US reporting completion and change-classification packet
summary: Original synthetic close, estimate, statement-mapping and accounting-change cases for the four selected reporting routes.
jurisdiction: United States; private nongovernmental US GAAP with SEC counterexamples; synthetic only

data.scope: All entities, dates, amounts, invoices, estimates, classifications, approvals and reporting outcomes are synthetic assumptions. They support evidence routing only.

examples.title: Close population and later invoice boundary
examples.calculation: Only the 3,000 January service obligation is proposed for January; the 3,000 February service is excluded. The 6,000 later payment is evidence to investigate, not an automatic January entry.
controls: Tie invoice service dates to cutoff
Retain journal packet and reviewer status
counterexamples: A small amount treated as automatically immaterial

examples.title: New estimate information versus known omission
examples.calculation: The 200 increase is a prospective estimate layer only if the 12 unit cost is new information. The 400 invoice is an error candidate if the obligation and amount were available at the earlier close.
counterexamples: Estimate uncertainty does not convert a known omission into a new estimate
A changed estimate does not prove the original was erroneous

examples.title: Adjusted trial balance to statement and disclosure map
examples.calculation: The synthetic map records each balance, statement destination, current/noncurrent fact, note cross-reference, comparative period and reviewer status. A private entity route is separated from an SEC Regulation S-X route.
controls: Every balance has one destination or exception
Notes and comparatives cross-reference the mapping
counterexamples: A private entity is not an SEC filer because its layout resembles Form 10-K
An XBRL tag does not prove the accounting or disclosure is correct

examples.title: Policy, estimate and error matrix

facts.policy_case: Adopt a permitted standard using its effective-date transition
facts.estimate_case: Revise useful life from new operating evidence
facts.error_case: Omitted an available invoice from the prior close

examples.calculation: No correction or restatement is executed. Each branch retains the original facts, information cutoff, affected periods, issued status, statement/disclosure effects and reviewer decision required before action.
controls: Quantify all affected statements and disclosures
Route current Topic 250 and professional review
counterexamples: Future guidance is not current default
A new estimate is not an error solely because it changes
An omitted available fact is not made prospective by labeling it uncertain

limitations: Synthetic facts are not ERP, ledger, filing, valuation or professional evidence.
The examples do not decide current ASC 250 treatment, materiality, restatement or SEC applicability.
No action is executed by this package.
